messages:
sam.prod: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A re: API / Console / Optimize timelines. jotting down action items and a few clarifying q's.
nina.lead: thanks Sam — hit me with it.
sam.prod: 1) API model variant rollout: you said "latency-first variants" will be available soon. will this be a new model name in the catalog or a routing policy behavior?
nina.lead: routing policy behavior + variant tags. models remain same canonical id; variants will appear as metadata (e.g., model: redwood-v2, variant: latency-1). catalog will show perf profile.
omar.engineer: implementation detail: we'll surface `x-rw-model-variant` header on responses and a `variant` field in inference logs. sample: ```text
x-rw-model-variant: latency-1
```
sam.prod: 2) Console: per-route cost history — any SLA on data freshness?
nina.lead: 1m rollups for live dashboards, 15m for historical rollups. GA in 10-12 weeks. hosted plans get 90d backfill; Dedicated requires agent v2.1 for backfill.
rahul.cto: note: cost attribution model changed slightly to attribute cached tokens differently. we'll include migration notes.
sam.prod: 3) Optimize: when suggestions appear, can teams auto-apply? and is there a dry-run?
nina.lead: UI will allow one-click apply with a required confirmation modal. API also available for automation. dry-run mode shows estimated cost/sla impact but does not change runtime until explicitly applied.
omar.engineer: suggestions will include a confidence score and an explanation snippet (e.g., "increase max_batch to 32 for short prompts; estimated 18% cost saving").
sam.prod: 4) canaries & rollback: what telemetry triggers an automatic rollback? threshold specifics?
omar.engineer: automatic rollback if error rate exceeds 1% absolute or increases by 3x baseline, or if p95 latency increases > 30% (configurable per release).
rahul.cto: well publish the default thresholds and guidance; teams can tweak per release.
sam.prod: logistics — how will teams sign up for betas and how will we notify customers?
nina.lead: beta sign-up via Console -> Settings -> Early Access. customers on Dedicated will get email via account reps. internal beta invites via #eng-releases and direct DM.
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary rollout wave 1 on 2026-06-02T02:30:00Z to us-west-2. dry-run complete.
sam.prod: great. one more: will the latency variants be compatible with streaming + function calling?
omar.engineer: yes, streaming supported; function-calling supported but we recommend testing the variant with long-running function calls as cache behavior may differ.
sam.prod: thanks all — i'll compile a short FAQ and post in #product and #eng-releases.
nina.lead: please include the flag docs and the sample logs.
rahul.cto: appreciate the follow-up.
notes: short all-hands follow-up thread summarizing timelines, beta sign-up, canary thresholds, headers/variants, and backfill notes
